title: One Jar Is Salt  (其中一罐是盐)

segments.t: 周二晚上十点，泰莎上楼休息脚踝后，汉娜和格雷厄姆走进厨房，看到阿瑟正得意地给烘焙台上的两个一模一样的白色陶瓷罐盖上盖子。先完整听一遍吧。
Good night, team! I refilled Tessa's two big white jars so everything looks tidy for dawn!
Wait, Arthur: those two white ceramic jars had little paper labels underneath!
Oh, the paper got damp when I wiped the counter, so I threw both labels away.
Tell me both jars held sugar, boss. Please tell me both were sugar.
No, one bag was fine white caster sugar and one bag was fine white sea salt!
Which jar got the sugar, Arthur: the left jar or the right jar?!
Left! Definitely left... Or did I turn both jars around when I polished the lids?
If Hannah whisks four spoons of sea salt into Wednesday's lemon tarts, the city clerk will run!
Do not panic: tomorrow at six we taste a tiny pinch on a clean spoon before baking!
Write a big red note right now, Hannah! Wait, who is knocking at the front gate at ten at night?!
Look through the lobby window: a woman in a blue coat holding a city folder?!
Wait, is the city clerk not supposed to come Wednesday at three, NOT Tuesday night?!
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段让人倒吸一口凉气的厨房惨案。
Good night, team! I refilled Tessa's two big white jars so everything looks tidy for dawn!
'晚安，团队！我把泰莎那两个白色大罐子重新装满了，这样天亮时一切看起来都整整齐齐的！'
Wait, Arthur: those two white ceramic jars had little paper labels underneath!
'等等，阿瑟：那两个白色陶瓷罐子底下可是贴着小纸标签的！'
Oh, the paper got damp when I wiped the counter, so I threw both labels away.
'哦，我擦台面的时候纸弄湿了，所以我就把两张标签都扔了。'
Tell me both jars held sugar, boss. Please tell me both were sugar.
'告诉我两个罐子里装的都是糖，老板。求您告诉我两个都是糖。'
No, one bag was fine white caster sugar and one bag was fine white sea salt!
'不，一袋是精细的白幼砂糖，一袋是精细的白海盐！'
Which jar got the sugar, Arthur: the left jar or the right jar?!
'哪个罐子装了糖，阿瑟：左边的罐子还是右边的罐子？！'
Left! Definitely left... Or did I turn both jars around when I polished the lids?
'左边！肯定是左边……还是说我擦亮盖子的时候把两个罐子转了个方向？'
If Hannah whisks four spoons of sea salt into Wednesday's lemon tarts, the city clerk will run!
'要是汉娜在周三的柠檬挞里拌进去四勺海盐，市政办事员绝对会夺门而出！'
Do not panic: tomorrow at six we taste a tiny pinch on a clean spoon before baking!
'别慌：明天六点烤之前，我们拿把干净的勺子尝一点点就行了！'
Write a big red note right now, Hannah! Wait, who is knocking at the front gate at ten at night?!
'现在马上写张大红纸条，汉娜！等等，晚上十点谁在敲前门？！'
Look through the lobby window: a woman in a blue coat holding a city folder?!
'从门厅的窗户看出去：一个穿着蓝大衣的女人拿着市政文件夹？！'
Wait, is the city clerk not supposed to come Wednesday at three, NOT Tuesday night?!
'等等，市政办事员不是应该周三下午三点来吗，而不是周二晚上？！'
听最后一遍这段悬念迭起的场景吧。

烘焙台上放着没有标签的盐罐和糖罐——周二深夜大门口还传来了带着市政文件的敲门声！第四集到此结束——我们第五集见。
See you tomorrow!
